Commentary.Commentary: The Indian spinners were impressive in the middle overs. The trio of Kuldeep, Jadhav and Patel hunted down four wickets and gave away only 134 runs in their combined 30 overs. Also a point worth mentioning - 89 balls out of 180 from them were dot balls. The pitch is a good one for batting but it's supposed to slow down. However, dew might be a factor which won't help Australia's cause. Let's see how the chase pans out. Do join us in a short while.

It was the 87-run partnership between Travis Head and Marcus Stoinis which revived their innings a bit but once they departed it was again a struggle for the Aussies. The lower order just failed to get going against the accurate Indian bowling and eventually managed a below par total.

After winning yet another toss and electing to bat, the visitors got off to a brilliant start. Their in-form openers, David Warner and Aaron Finch, once again looked in the mood and played some good shots to set the tone. However, the wicket of Finch, later followed by Smith initiated a collapse. They lost three wickets in a jiffy for only 18 runs and were staring down the barrel.

Impressive death bowling by India! Once again Bumrah and Bhuvneshwar were simply outstanding in their job, especially towards the end and never allowed Australia off the hook. Their effectiveness was so much that the Aussies managed just a single boundary in the last 50 balls. Outstanding stuff from the Men in Blue and they head into the break with the momentum on their side.

OUT! The off stump goes for a walk! Bhuvneshwar angles in a full ball around off, angling in, Coulter-Nile clears his front leg and swings his bat blindly across the line. Misses the ball completely and the off stump is uprooted. Australia end on 242/9!
Nathan Coulter-Nile walks in next!

OUT! Faulkner is run out! A length ball outside off, Faulkner bends his back knee and goes aerially over mid on. Doesn't carry to Hardik this time in the deep. James however wants the second run and turns for it. Pandya fires in a flat throw to the keeper and Dhoni takes the bails off quickly. Not even in the frame, Faulkner.
Too full in length and on middle, Cummins eases it down to long on for a single.
Forces a length ball through covers for one.
Short and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dropped by Hardik Pandya! Faulkner aims to go downtown, attempts to clear long on but fails to make proper connection. Pandya although drops a sitter in the deep. A single taken.
Pat Cummins walks in next.

OUT! End of the Wade show! An 18-ball 20 from him. His little knock was studded with shots from toe end of the bat. A full toss by Bumrah to which Wade swings his blade. It catches the outer half of the bat and Rahane at sweeper cover catches the ball with utmost ease.
Too full in length on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.

Ho! Ho! Ho! Wade is putting on a comedy show. Ball is flying, bat is flying, only the Australian innings ain't flying. A low full toss on off, Wade swings and swings hard. Loses the grip and the bat flies behind. A little connection which was made sends the ball in the air and it lands safely inside the circle at covers. A single taken.
Stays back to a shortish ball and punches it through extra cover for a single.
Bumrah keeps his line straight and Wade lofts it over mid on. It goes on the bounce to the fielder in the deep and they take a single.

Run out chance missed! Poor from Bumrah, there. A length ball on off, Faulkner swings it from the lower half of the bat to deep mid-wicket and wants the second run. Wade however is not interested. Luckily for Australia, Bumrah fails to collect the throw from the deep and eventually Faulkner makes it safely. Only one added to the total.
A low full toss on the pads, following the batsman down the leg side, James just manages to dig it out through mid on and retains strike with a single. 12 from the over!
Too full in length on off, Wade drives it down to long off and rotates the strike.

A touch short in length on middle, Wade swings his bat across the line, throws all his power behind it but still fails to get the proper connection. It goes on one drop to the fielder in the deep mid-wicket region and they take a couple.
A low full toss on middle, Faulkner forces it down to long on for a single. Hardik was very swift to get to the ball in the deep.
Kumar replies with a terrific fuller length ball on middle, Wade squeezes it out past the diving bowler for a single.
SIX! Wade finally connects one from the middle of the bat. A length delivery outside off, Matthew exercises his arms and sends it packing over long off for a maximum.
Slower delivery, on a shortish length around middle, Wade waits and eases it behind square leg for a single.
Serves one on the pads, Wade tries to heave over the leg side but is early into his swing of the bat. It takes the bottom edge and goes in the vacant mid-wicket area. A couple of runs taken.
Full and on leg, Faulkner digs it out to mid-wicket for a single.
Angling away from the batsman, fuller in length, Wade slices his drive square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
A yorker around off, Wade tries to be fancy. Attempts to play the paddle scoop but once again it kisses the toe end of his bat and rolls back to the bowler. His idea is right but not the execution.
Slightly short in length outside off, Faulkner goes hard at it and hits it without much force to mid off. They cross for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Wade tries driving through covers but it takes the toe end of the bat and rolls back to the bowler.
Terrific bowling. Full and straight, Wade gets behind the line and hits it back to the bowler.
Straighter in line, it's quietly played behind square leg for a single.
Drops it on a length just around off, not enough room again, Faulkner gives the charge but mistimes his punch shot to covers.
Back of a length ball on off, Wade gets across the stumps a bit and pulls it across the line. Not enough timing but it rolls in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Faulkner eases it off his pads through backward square leg for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
Outside off, Faulkner pushes at it and misses. Dhoni fumbles a bit and they steal a bye. Tremendous over by JB!
Good length ball on off, defended from the back foot.

NOT OUT! It has bounced in front. Good length delivery outside off, Faulkner tries to run it down to third man but it takes the outside edge and goes behind. It's dying in front of Dhoni who gets down low to grab it. However, he is not sure that he has taken it cleanly. The umpires come together and refer it upstairs. Soft signal is out. The replays though confirm it just bounced in front of Dhoni's gloves.
James Faulkner has been caught behind by Dhoni via a tumbling effort. The Indian keeper isn't sure if he's taken it cleanly, so it's taken upstairs to confirm. The soft signal is out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
In walks James Faulkner.

OUT! Stoinis has to depart! Bumrah gets a length ball to shape back into the batsman from around off, Stoinis tries playing across the line but misses and is thudded on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Marcus has a chat with his partner who advises him to take the referral. The Hawk Eye shows that the impact is with the umpire's call and it's hitting the stumps. Stoinis has to walk back, like Head, he also misses out on his fifty.
Appeal for an lbw against Marcus Stoinis. Up goes the finger. Stoinis has a chat with Wade and opts for the DRS.
Good length ball on off, defended back.
Jasprit Bumrah returns to the bowling attack.
Turning away from the batsman, Wade opens the face of the bat but fails to generate much timing. Rolls to first slip.
Sliding down the leg side, a fine sweep shot by Wade to fine leg for a brace.
Drags his length short around off, Marcus hits it through covers for one.
Full and on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Interesting shot. Wade premeditates the sweep shot and ends up toe ending it back towards the bowler.
Turning away from the batsman, punched down to sweeper cover for a single.
Matthew Wade walks in next.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Axar spears in a fuller length ball in the line of the middle stump, Head is caught in two minds, initially shapes up for the sweep shot but then tries to heave it over the leg side. The length is not quite there and also he seems to get beaten by the pace. It sneaks through and goes on to rattle the stumps. End of an 87-run stand, devil's number for Australia. It strikes.
Drifting down the leg side, Stoinis nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Sprays it way wide outside off, left alone by Marcus.
Quicker ball, Stoinis punches it back to the bowler.
Drags a short ball from outside off and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Appeal for an lbw! Loopy ball landing around off and spinning in, Head comes down the track and tries to flick but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire ain't interested.
Fuller in length on middle, driven back to the bowler. Eventful over, 7 from it!

In the air... safe! Stoinis is living dangerously here. A flighted ball around leg, a googly, Stoinis runs down the track to heave it over the leg side but it takes the outside edge. Flies in the air but goes on one bounce to Axar at backward point.

Stoinis survives! Floated full ball on middle and off, Marcus tries to sweep but fails to middle it. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the umpire raises his finger after thinking for a while. Stoinis opts for the DRS and the Ultra Edge detects a bottom edge.
Marcus Stoinis is adjudged lbw. He has reviewed it.
Hangs on the back foot and punches it down to long off for a single.

FOUR! Boom! Loopy full ball outside off, spinning back in, Head kneels and slogs it firmly over mid-wicket for a boundary. Long extension of the arms and he fetched it very well from outside off. 200 up for Australia!
Short and wide outside off, Head punches it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Darts into the batsman, around middle, 90 kph, Stoinis goes back to hit it straight but it takes the inside edge and speeds down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker one, down the leg side, Head fails to defend and it goes off his pads to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Gets back inside the crease and helps it with the spin to square leg.
Skidding down the leg side, Marcus bends his back leg and paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish and on off, punched down to long off for a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the game. And with that, Axar Patel is back on.
FOUR! 11 from the over! Short by Kuldeep, outside off, Stoinis remains inside the crease and cracks it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Goes on the back foot and punches it through covers for a run.

Flighted full ball on off, spinning in, Marcus shimmies down the track for a big shot but gets it away from the inner half of the bat. It goes over mid-wicket, now there is a fielder in that zone, and hence only a single.
Walks down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
FOUR! Another slog sweep, this time by Marcus Stoinis and he finds the fence. Flatter and fuller on off, Marcus swings and goes over mid-wicket. Big gap there.
Loopy full ball on off, Head gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Rahane makes a good stop in the deep and they take a single.
Fullish and outside off, Stoinis drives it off his front foot to point.
Wicket to wicket line, on a fuller length, Stoinis covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Slower this time, fuller in length outside off, Stoinis pushes inside the line and misses.
Spears in a low full toss on middle, Stoinis does well to dig it out.
Full in length and outside off, Head goes hard at it with his drive and edges it down to third man. A streaky single.
Play and a miss! Length delivery outside off, angling away, Head flashes and misses.
A little short around middle, Head gets back and works it behind square leg for a single.
Short and way wide outside off, would have been a wide had Head left it but he chases it and forces it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Flighted and too full on middle, Travis gets forward and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Goes on the back foot and turns it behind square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery around off, Marcus gets back and hits it to mid-wicket.
Flighted full ball on middle and off, spinning away, Head gets forward and defends it from the outer half of the bat to point. It goes in the gap and they take a single.

Drinks break. After a flurry of wickets, the current partnership has steadied things up. The pitch is looking on the slower side, so, Australia should not be aiming too high. 13 overs left in the innings, if both Head and Stoinis last the distance, the visitors can expect at least another 100 to their total. India would have to do better in their death bowling than the last game.
Fuller in length around off, angling in, Stoinis gets behind the line and defends it back.
Good length ball on middle, not much room, Head gets behind the line and keeps it out towards mid on. A sharp single taken.
Full in length around middle and leg, Head defends it back with a straight bat.
Play and a miss! Bumrah takes the pace off the delivery, on a length and angling away from the left-hander, Head is early into the shot, throws his bat at it and misses.
Width on offer outside off, short in length, Stoinis slashes it behind backward point for a run.
Length ball just around off, Marcus pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Hangs back to a shortish ball and punches it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up and outside off, driven uppishly past the bowler to long off for a run.
Full floated on off, driven back to the bowler.
Whoa! Extra bounce. Flighted and wide outside off, Head swings and misses. Dhoni collects the ball in front of his face and falls down.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
A teasing delivery, flighted and full on middle, Stoinis advances down the track and plays a nothing shot. It hits his pads and rolls to covers.
An overpitched ball on off, driven past the bowler and Pandey made a sliding half stop at mid off. A single taken. 50-run stand comes up!
Outside off, left alone.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Marcus flicks it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket for a run.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.

Not out! Nothing on the Ultra Edge! A flatter delivery, again a googly outside off, Head tries to sweep but misses. Dhoni collects the ball which was a shade low and appeals. Not given and Kohli without consulting Dhoni takes the DRS. The replays roll in and nothing was found. Too restless, Virat. Should have consulted MS!
Appeal for a caught behind as Dhoni collects the ball. Not given and Virat Kohli who was at first slip immediately signals for the DRS...
Beautifully tossed up ball outside off, turning away after landing, Head pushes inside the line and misses. Didn't pick the googly, there.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and drives it back firmly. Kuldeep fails to stop it in his follow through and concedes a single.
Tossed up ball on off, turning in, Marcus defends it at the last moment off the shoulder of the bat.
Flatter and shorter, it's a googly, Head slaps it through the line but finds Kohli at short cover.
Loopy full ball on middle, spinning in, Stoinis fails to flick and it goes off his pads to short fine leg for a leg bye.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on.
Short and outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
Flighted and on middle, defended back quietly.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it to covers.
Flatter and on middle, punched back off the front foot to short mid-wicket.
Slower delivery, a touch short and outside off, Stoinis goes down and sweeps it in front of square leg for a single.
Fires a full ball on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a single.
Flighted and outside off, driven back to the bowler. 13 from the over. expensive end to a good spell. Jadhav has bowled out, 10-0-48-1, brilliant from a part-timer!
Turning back into the batsman, Head hangs back and hits it down to long on for a single.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
SIX! Just over Rahul (sub) at long on! Loopy full ball on middle, Stoinis runs down the track and thwacks it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Good use of the feet by Marcus!
Advances down the track and eases it down to long on for a run. 150 up for Australia!
FOUR! Quicker one, fired down the leg side, Head played a well-controlled sweep shot past short fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! Streaky! This has happened for the second time. Lovely loopy delivery, drifting into the batsman, landing full on middle and curling away. Stoinis tries to defend off the front foot but it takes the outside edge and sneaks through the gap between first slip and the keeper. Marcus is very lucky!
Goes on the back foot and punches it with the spin to covers.
Presses forward and defends it watchfully. There was some extra bounce too.
Arm ball around off, skidding back in, Stoinis gets forward to defend but it takes the inside edge.
Quicker ball, landing on middle and turning away, Marcus gets back to defend but is squared up. It runs off the outside edge past the backward point fielder and they take a brace.
Tossed up ball wide outside off, Marcus tries to sweep but misses by good six inches.
Guided down to fine leg by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flighted and outside off, it's driven back towards the left of the bowler.
Knocks it down with the spin to long on for one.
Gets on the front foot and drives it to extra cover.
Tickles it off his pads through the leg side for a run.

Shout for an lbw! Spinning down the leg side, Stoinis gets down on one knee for the paddle sweep but misses. Dhoni appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Stoinis is surprised that it's not given as a wide.
Tossed up ball outside off, turning in, Head tries to sweep but misses and is hit on the ribs. A stifled appeal but nothing doing.
Dances down to the pitch of the delivery and flicks it on the leg side. Finds mid-wicket.
Fires it in outside off, Head goes on the back foot in defense.
FOUR! Flighted full ball outside off, Head plays a crunching cover drive, finds the gap and fetches himself a boundary.
Spinning back in from outside off, punched from the crease to short mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on off, hit back from the front foot.
Slow loopy off spinner on off, Marcus defends it off his front foot.
Goes flat with a round-arm action, angles it in on off, Head goes deep inside the crease and strokes it past short extra cover for one.
Fullish and just outside leg, Stoinis clears his front leg and eases it down to long on for a run.
Straighter in line and it's worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, Head hangs back and punches it to covers.
Flatter through the air, fuller in length, driven to short extra cover.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.

EDGY FOUR! Axar slows this up in the air and serves a full ball on off, spinning away a touch, Stoinis gets forward to defend but it takes the outside edge and runs through the gap between first slip and the keeper. Rahane didn't even react, can't blame him, to be honest.
Goes on the back foot and turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Appeal for an lbw, not given. Quicker full ball outside off, Stoinis fails to sweep and is hit on the pads. The impact seems outside the line.
Leans forward to a slower full ball on off and pushes it to extra cover.
Around off, defended from the back foot.

FOUR! First boundary after 52 balls for Australia, the going has been really tough for them. Head dances down the track to a full ball and drills it straight back past the bowler for a crunching boundary.
Shorter and outside off, spinning away, Head cuts it straight to point.
Tries playing through the line but it takes the outer half of the bat and goes to point.
Skidding back into the batsman from around off, Head moves back and pushes it to covers.
Another watchful front foot defensive shot by Marcus to end an exceptional over. A wicket and a run from it.
Bowls a full ball on off with a silly mid off in place. Stoinis keeps his bat and pad close in defense.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish and on middle, pushed down to mid on.
Marcus Stoinis is in next to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Australia are falling apart now and the Nagpur crowd is dancing up and down. Patel serves it a shade quicker through the air, it's flat and full around off at 91 kph, turning away, Handscomb goes down on one knee to attempt the cross-batted shot over mid-wicket but it catches the outside edge and loops behind the keeper. Rahane runs back from first slip and grabs it safely. 50th international wicket for Axar!
This one straightens a touch from around off, Handscomb tries turning it on the leg side but gets a little leading edge towards the cover fielder.
Remains on the back foot and defends it towards the cover fielder.
Shortish and on off, Handscomb moves back and hits it firmly past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a run.
Slower this time, full and on off, Handscomb kneels and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Short and on off, Head rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Once again fires it in, flat and on middle, Head goes back and keeps it out towards the bowler.
Fires in a fuller length ball on leg, it's hit right back and Jadhav dives to make the half stop. He parries it to short mid-wicket and stops the batsmen from crossing over.
Slower loopy full ball outside off, Peter strides forward and pushes it with the spin to covers. A successful over for India, 3 runs and a wicket from it.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut straight to point.
Flattish and on middle, forced down to long on for a single.
Travis Head arrives.

OUT! Warner holes out! He finds the fielder with surgical precision. A flighted full ball outside off, turning back in a bit, Warner jumps out of the crease and tries to chip it over mid-wicket. But he ends up hitting it too well. The ball goes towards wide long on where Pandey is perfectly placed. He accepts the catch gleefully and it's a body blow to Australia. They once again appear to be losing the plot after a good start. Over to their middle order which has been pretty inconsistent.
Flatter ball, on middle, it's punched down to long off for one.
Full flighted ball outside off, it's driven down the ground to long off for a single. The extra cover fielder put in a fancy dive but to no avail.

Handscomb fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it in front of square leg. Manish Pandey moves across to his left from fine leg, dives and parries it to Axar who has come in from deep mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Shorter and outside off, it's cut through cover-point for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler.
Switches to around the wicket for the southpaw and angles in a full ball on off, Warner drives it to extra cover.
Quicker and fuller outside off, Handscomb pushes it out to square leg and crosses.
Loopy full ball on off, Peter walks forward and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Gets behind the line and hits it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, punched from the crease to sweeper cover for a single.
This time Peter gets his drive past the bowler and collects a single as the ball goes to long off.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it back to Axar.
Beauty of a delivery! Drifting into the batsman, landing just around off and turning just enough to beat Handscomb who was looking to defend from the back foot.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to long on for a single. A successful over for India.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Peter Handscomb walks in next.

OUT! Trapped in front! Jadhav, the golden-arm man, strikes again for his side. I don't know how I get wickets, Jadhav said in an interview. Well, as long as you're picking it, no one cares. It's a massive breakthrough as well. The Australian skipper walks back, dejected. As far as the delivery is concerned, it's a straightforward one, landing full and around middle, not doing much, Smith tries to play the sweep shot but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up. Kedar is all smiles and is mobbed by his teammates.

Fifty for Warner, his 17th in ODIs! Another fine knock from the Australia vice-captain. A flatter shorter ball on off, Warner rocks back and smashes it past extra cover for a single. He needs to keep on batting and get a big one!
Very full in length on leg, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and full outside off, Smith drives it down to long off for another run in the over.
Too full in length on middle, Warner eases it down to long on and hands the strike back to his skipper.
Gets forward and drives a full ball back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on middle, shorter in length, Smith punches it down to long on for one.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Axar Patel to begin proceedings after the break, he replaces Kedar Jadhav.

Drinks break. It's been good going for Australia. They started extremely well after opting to bat but the introduction of spin and the fall of Finch's wicket have slowed things up a bit. Important passage of play coming up now...
Shortish and outside off, hit from the back foot to extra cover, not in the gap.
A touch short and outside off, Warner rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for one.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and flighted outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Uses his feet and eases it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! That's a very good shot! Too full in length on this occasion, giving plenty of room, Warner spots that and drills it through covers for a cracking boundary. 8 from the over!
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and drives it to long off for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, Smith presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Once again it's a googly, around middle, David works it in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Ooohhh....this one stays low. A googly on middle, Smith does well to keep it out in the gap on the leg side for a run.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Warner rocks back and punches it down to long off for a single.

Slower this time, full and on middle, Smith flicks it with nice timing to mid-wicket where Kohli makes a diving stop. Tidy bowling by Kedar, to some extent he has halted Australia's proceedings with his part-time spin bowling.
Wide! Quicker full ball down the leg side, Smith fails to hit it across the line.
Skidding back into the batsman from around off, Warner moves back and helps it to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and shorter on off, Warner cuts but finds the backward point fielder.
Slower through the air, full and angling in from outside off, David is on the front foot as he defends it back.
A loopy full toss on off, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Too full and too wide outside off, Warner squeezes it out through covers for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, turning away a bit, Warner tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls in front of square leg. A single taken. End of another fine over by Kuldeep.
Walks down the track to a flighted full ball and drives it to long off for a single.
Shortish and on off, Smith gets back but fails to time his punch shot well. Hits it back to Yadav.
Loopy full ball on off, Warner reverse sweeps it with the spin to backward point where Bumrah makes a tumbling stop. A single taken.
Uses his feet to come down the track and flicks a full ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, punched from the back foot to extra cover.
Gets back to punch it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Warner cuts it from the back foot but finds the backward point fielder.
Full flighted on middle, knocked down to mid on.
Wide! Way wide outside off, it's called a wide.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Warner defends it from the crease to the off side.
Fails to land this ball, Smith flicks the full toss to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Warner has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Kedar Jadhav to bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Maiden!
A googly around off, Smith fails to read the variation and is squared up in defense. Does well eventually to keep it out safely.
Action replay of the previous ball. Once again Smith finds the mid-wicket fielder with his flick shot.
Works it on the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Full flighted ball on off, Smith walks forward and hits it across the line. Rahane dives from short mid-wicket to stop the ball.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it back.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. No run.
On a length and outside off, Smith plays a loose drive towards point and takes a single.
FOUR! That's some way to get off the mark! Fuller in length and outside off, Smith leans forward and caresses it through covers for a glorious boundary.
Skipper Steven Smith walks in next.

OUT! Finch falls! Pandya strikes and the Nagpur crowd erupts. He serves it on a length around off, Finch tries to go over the cover region but fails to get the timing right. It balloons in the air, Bumrah moves swiftly across to his left from mid off to take the catch in multiple attempts. In fact, the replays after confirming that it was not a no ball, also showed that Jasprit just somehow hung on to the catch. The Indian team is celebrating and a dejected Finch walks back to the pavilion.
Aaron Finch is caught by the mid off fielder. The umpire wants to check for the front foot no ball and also whether Bumrah has taken it cleanly.
Slower delivery, on the pads, Warner nudges it down to fine leg and takes a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Warner plays it late and guides it fine down to third man. The fielder runs across to his left in the deep to make the stop. Two runs taken.
Advances down the track to take it on the full and forces it down to long on for a run. 3 runs from the first over of spin.
Tossed up ball around off, Finch kneels and sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Extra flight on this occasion, lands too full on middle, Warner punches it back and Kuldeep fails to stop it in his followthrough. It goes to long off and they take a single.
Slower one, full and on middle, pushed with the spin to cover again.
Probably a googly, full and around off turning back into the left-hander, Warner pushes it off his front foot to extra cover.
Flighted ball on middle, driven to short extra cover where Rahane made a fine diving stop.
Kuldeep Yadav comes into the attack. He against David Warner will be a contest to watch out. The chinaman so far has got the better of Warner. A slip in place.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. No run to end the Powerplay, Australia are 60/0.

FOUR! Seems like a deliberate edge, not too sure, at least Finch made it look so. Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch remains inside the crease and pushes inside the line. It takes the outside edge and hurries down to the third man fence.
Full and on off, 133 kph, Finch gets forward and defends it to the off side.

Loose shot! Short delivery outside off, Warner gets deep inside the crease and tries to power it over covers. But due to the slowness of the delivery, he is early into the shot. It takes the outside edge as a result and speeds down to third man for a single.
Slower delivery, on a length around off and cutting back into the batsman, Aaron eases it behind square leg and collects a single.
Fullish and on off, Finch drives it off his front foot to covers.
Hardik Pandya is the first bowling change.
Fuller and on off, driven through the line but straight to mid off.

Short in length and outside off, Finch stands tall inside the crease and hits it on the up. The extra cover fielder puts in a dive to take the pace off the ball. Rahane cuts it from mid off after that and they cross for a single.
On a length and around middle, not offering any room Aaron Finch, stays back foot and keeps it out on the off side.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Finch punches from the back foot to mid off.
Width on offer outside off, David calmly guides it through point and rotates the strike.

FOUR! That's a very nice shot! Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Warner stays back to create some room and punches it sweetly through the cover region for a boundary. The placement was the key. 50 up for Australia!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Another expensive over by Bumrah, 13 from it!

FOUR! Best of the lot. There is something very delightful about boundaries down the ground. A leg stump half-volley by Bumrah, missing the yorker mark by a few inches. Finch brings down a straight bat and caresses it past the left side of the mid on fielder.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Finch! A pitched up delivery and angling into the pads of the batsman, Aaron clips it off his pads and it races through. Kedar Jadhav runs across to his left from deep mid-wicket but to no avail.
FOUR! It beats short fine leg and is always a boundary after that. Full in length and on middle, angling in, Finch closes the face of the bat and flicks it past the diving Axar Patel.
Angling away from the batsman, on a length and outside off, Warner uses the depth of his crease and steers it down to third man for a single.
Angling into the batsman, on middle, Finch brings down a straight bat and eases it to mid on. Good over by Bhuvi, just two runs from it.
Lands it on a length just outside off, Finch gets forward and pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Warner moves back and turns it in front of square leg for a run.
Fuller length ball in the line of the stumps, Warner doesn't get entirely forward and blocks it back with a vertical bat. Not the best of techniques to deal with fuller length balls.
Sliding down the leg side, Finch nudges it in front of square leg and takes a single.
Full and angling into the batsman, Finch takes a half stride forward and flicks it off his pads to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! No half measures this time! Back of a length delivery outside off, from around the wicket, Warner camps back and packs a punch through covers for a powerful boundary. Runs coming thick and fast for Australia, 12 from this over.

FOUR! Up and over! A short-arm jab by Warner to a shortish ball angled into him, he gets it from the middle of the bat and it just goes over Rohit Sharma at mid-wicket. Heart in mouth stuff for the Aussie fans.
Tickles it off his pads through mid-wicket for a single.

Full and angling into the batsman, Finch gets forward and brings his bat and pad together in defense. Bumrah appeals thinking it's pad first but the umpire remains unmoved. The replays show that it never hit Finch's pad after taking the inner half of the bat.
Short in length and angling away from the batsman, Warner stays put and slashes it through backward point for a run.
An off pace delivery on middle, shorter in length, Warner pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

Kumar bowls a length delivery but the line is on middle and leg. Finch glances it off his hips through backward square leg for a couple of runs. 7 from this over, 16 in last two, Australia are picking up their scoring rate.
On a length and outside off, angling in, Finch defends it from the crease to the off side.
Fullish and on middle, rolling his fingers over the ball, Bhuvi. Warner quietly plays it to the left side of the short mid-wicket fielder and crosses for a run.
A little bit of width on offer outside off, Warner strokes it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
Length delivery outside off, Warner pushes it from the back foot to mid off.

FOUR! That's a great shot, plenty of bottom hand involved. Back of a length delivery just around off, Warner goes back and plays a half-pull, half-flick shot. Timing is good and the outfield does the rest. It races away in front of square leg and crosses the fence in no time. Suddenly, there is a flurry of boundaries for Australia.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. 9 from the over, a good one for Australia!
The last two shots prompted for a field change. The slip moves out and there is an extra protection in the deep on the leg side. Bumrah bowls a shortish ball on off and it's punched down to mid off.

FOUR! This is a lightning quick outfield. Bumrah is once again on the shorter side, Finch drags it from outside off and still times his pull shot quite decently through mid-wicket. It just races through this outfield and the deep square leg fielder fails to cut it off.
FOUR! Finch takes the calculative risk and breaks the shackles. Short in length around off, Aaron reads the length early, sits back and pulls it nicely over mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball just outside off, angling in, Finch tries playing straight but it takes the inside half of the bat and goes to mid on.
A rising delivery, from around leg, Warner goes on his toes to pull it. Doesn't middle it well but good enough for a single as it rolls down to fine leg off the inside half of his blade.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, David taps it down on the off side and calls his partner through for a quick single.
Nicely done by Warner this time. Watches the line closely and judges the movement well. Covers everything before blocking it with a dead straight bat.
Slightly short in length and around middle, Warner goes back to turn it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Kumar is getting some movement from this deck.
Stays back to punch it towards mid on and steals a sharp single.
Serves it on a length on off, Finch defends it back from the back foot.

Shout for an lbw! Good length ball in the line of the stumps, Warner stays back to hit it across the line but misses and is hit high on the back pad. They appeal and the batsmen cross as the ball travels to third man. Too high to be given out, shows the replay. Also, it's given as a run. Maybe, some inside edge.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch punches it off his back foot, not timed well enough and it goes to mid off. Bumrah begins his spell with a maiden!
Finch tries to tap and run but it has gone too straight towards the cover fielder and he aborts the plan.
Goes full and angles it in from around off, Finch drives it through the line, however, not from the middle of the bat and it rolls straight towards the cover-point fielder.
On a good length and just outside off, Finch gets across the stumps a bit to cover the line and defends it back.
Fuller in length and outside off, Aaron presses forward and drives it nicely through the line. Finds the cover fielder.
Serves a length ball first up, around off and angling in, Finch sticks back and closes the face of his bat to help it towards mid-wicket.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball.
Once again it's the identical length, too straight in line though, Warner works it to mid-wicket. Just two from the over, good start!
Back of a length delivery on off, David defends it off his back foot to the off side.

Edged but safe! A little bit of away movement off the seam, just outside off, Warner feels for it and edges it behind. Rohit dives across to his right and stops it on one bounce. Seems to have hurt his hands in the process.
Good length delivery around middle and off, Warner gets behind the line and blocks it back safely.
A touch short in length and it's around the leg stump line, Warner once again tucks it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
A good length delivery on middle, Warner goes on the back foot and eases it off his pads through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Australia are away!

It's time to get underway. The in-form openers of Australia, David Warner and Aaron Finch stride out to the middle. India are beginning with the pace and swing of Bhuvneshwar Kumar. A false start first up as Warner saw some disturbance near the sightscreen. But all set now. Two slips in place...
National anthem time. The players from both sides are out in the centre.

Virat Kohli says they need to get the processes right when they come out to play. Adds he expected Australia to fight back hard but his side played a good game of cricket in the last game. States the incentives are plenty every time you walk out to play. Opines the pitch looks pretty hard and it won't change too much, so it wouldn't have mattered even if his team batted first. Feels today's game will be an even contest. Reminds everyone that they chased down 350 last time they played Australia here, so that's a good thing for them. Ends by saying that there are three changes - Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Jasprit Bumrah and Kuldeep Yadav are in for Yuzvendra Chahal, Umesh Yadav and Mohammed Shami.

Steven Smith says they will have a bat first. Mentions the wicket looks pretty dry and mostly it will slow down as the game goes on. States they want to put up a good total first up. Let's everybody know it was nice to win the last one as they did well with the bat to get 330. Hopes to do the same today. Informs they have one forced change - Kane Richardson is sick and James Faulkner comes in his place.
Toss - Up goes the coin, Steven Smith once again calls it correctly, third time in a row, and AUSTRALIA WILL BAT!

Pitch - It's a relaid one and should be a lot better. It has a very dry look to it and there should be ample turn. Sunil Gavaskar, as always, feels it's a belter and he is expecting 300-plus on this pitch. Also, dew will be a factor later in the evening.

Australia on the other hand will be relieved after finally returning to winning ways away from home. They played a near perfect game in Bengaluru and would like to keep the same intensity. We are expecting a cracking contest on a Sunday afternoon, sit back and enjoy the commentary.

Welcome folks for the final ODI of the series. It's been a hard fought one, however, the results don't reflect the same. Both teams have had their share of opportunities in all the four past games but it's India who have dominated the key moments to go 3-1 up. The hosts would like to end on a high and there is an extra incentive for doing it - regaining the number one spot in ODIs.
